fields.summary_ko.0: The semiconductor ETF (SOXX) fell 11.4% over the past 30 days, with NVIDIA declining 4.27% on November 9 and an additional 6.5% on November 10 following governance controversy.
fields.summary_ko.1: With AI infrastructure spending reaching $121.4 billion in Q2, up 53.3% year-over-year, strong performers like ANET, TSM, and MU are attractive as NVIDIA alternatives in the current correction.
